zh.summary: 更換工具時保留已確認需求、權限與驗收契約，依變更影響規劃回歸，不用品牌或版本代替工程判斷。
objectives: 區分可替換工具與需要持續維持的責任。
說明 Agent、框架及多人需求改變的不同影響。
為遷移設定驗收與復原條件。

readingGuide.goal: 區分可替換工具與需要持續維持的責任。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 既有作品與測試紀錄，選擇一項假設的工具替換；本練習不必安裝新產品或使用真實資料。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。

sections.heading: 工具變動與持續責任
paragraphs: 這一課最重要的觀念，可以濃縮成一句話：
工具可以一直換，但你對成果的品質、安全與正確性所負的責任，不會因為換了工具而消失。
例如，你今天使用 ChatGPT 寫程式，明天改用 Claude Code，後天換成其他 AI Coding Agent。工具可能越來越厲害，但你仍然要確認：程式有沒有做對、資料有沒有外洩、權限有沒有失控，以及發生問題時能不能恢復。
這正是 [M09-04 原始教材](https://learn.cs-kairos.com/courses/aase/v1/m09/concepts/m09-04/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) 要教的核心。

sections.heading: 一、先用生活例子理解
paragraphs: 假設你是一家餐廳的老闆。
原本廚房使用傳統瓦斯爐，後來改用最新的智慧電磁爐。
新設備可能更快、更省能源，也能自動控制溫度。
但有三件事不能因此改變：

- 顧客點的餐仍然要正確。
- 食物仍然必須符合衛生與安全要求。
- 如果新設備壞掉，餐廳仍然需要有辦法處理訂單。
所以：
換設備 ≠ 重新定義什麼叫做一間好的餐廳。
軟體工程也是同樣的道理。
今天換了程式語言、AI 模型、開發框架或雲端平台，不代表以前確認過的使用者需求、資料安全與驗收標準，就能全部重新來過。

sections.heading: 二、哪些東西可以變？哪些東西要保留？
paragraphs: 請比較可替換工具與持續責任。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜可替換工具與持續責任
blocks.description: 兩欄為平行對照，窄版依序重排；責任可依新需求調整，但須明確決策、更新規格並重新驗證，工具不能自行決定。

items.title: 可以更換的工具
items.body:
AI 模型
Coding Agent
UI 開發框架
資料庫與部署方式
第三方套件

items.title: 必須持續履行的責任
items.body:
使用者真正的需求
業務規則與驗收條件
資料安全與權限
測試與故障復原
文件、交接與負責人

paragraphs: 右邊的內容也可能因新需求而調整，但必須經過明確決策、更新規格並重新驗證，不能讓工具自行決定。
例如醫院原本規定只有授權醫師可以查看特定病歷。
某天醫院更換了新的 AI 醫療系統。
即使新系統非常先進，也不能因為新工具操作方便，就允許所有員工查看病歷。
工具的能力與系統的授權，是兩回事。

sections.heading: 三、不同的技術變動，需要不同的檢查
paragraphs: 這是本課最有實務價值的地方。
工程師不能把所有的工具更新，都視為同一種事情。

blocks.caption: 對照表｜三、不同的技術變動，需要不同的檢查
rows: 更換 AI Coding Agent
從工具 A 換成工具 B 幫忙寫程式
AI 能碰哪些檔案、執行哪些命令、修改是否符合規格
更換 UI 框架
網站介面從 Vue 改為 React
按鈕、輸入、畫面狀態、下載、鍵盤操作、部署
單人系統變多人系統
個人記帳工具改成公司多人共用
登入身分、不同人的資料隔離、授權、稽核紀錄

paragraphs: ### 例子 A：更換 AI Coding Agent
假設你用 AI 開發銀行貸款試算系統。
原本的工具 A 能正確計算每月還款金額。現在你想改用工具 B。
不應只問：「工具 B 寫程式是不是更快？」
還需要問：
工具 B 是否讀取了正確需求？會不會修改不應修改的核心公式？能不能保留程式碼變更紀錄（Diff）？會不會偷偷呼叫外部服務，傳出敏感資料？
這代表換 AI 開發工具，重點是檢查開發流程、工具權限與實際產出的修改。
如果只是換了工具，但根本沒有重新執行程式，也不能宣稱「新工具已經通過驗收」。
### 例子 B：更換前端 UI 框架
假設你有一個學校成績查詢網站。
原本用 Vue 開發，現在改用 React。
計算學期平均成績的公式沒有改，但網站仍可能發生這些問題：

- 學生按下查詢卻沒有反應。
- 成績畫面顯示了上一位學生的資料。
- 匯出 PDF 的按鈕失效。
- 手機上的畫面無法正常操作。
因此，即使平均分數的單元測試全部通過，也不能代表網站遷移成功。
這牽涉到一個重要名詞：
回歸測試（Regression Testing），就是確認「以前正常的功能，經過修改後還是正常」。
更換 UI 框架，就要重新測試受影響的 UI 行為，而不只是原來的計算公式。
### 例子 C：從單人系統變成多人系統
假設你原本寫了一個個人記帳工具，只有自己使用。
現在你想提供給一百家企業使用。
原本的程式即使功能完全正確，也不能直接拿去上線。
因為你現在需要處理新的問題：
甲公司的員工是否能看到乙公司的帳本？公司主管能否查看員工私人資料？離職員工的權限何時撤銷？資料操作是否留下稽核紀錄？
這不是單純增加登入頁面。
它代表系統的身分管理、授權模型與資料治理都發生了改變。

sections.heading: 四、真正的遷移流程：不要先換工具，先定義成功
paragraphs: 我們可以用一個通用流程，處理任何產業的技術替換。

blocks.caption: 圖 2｜先定義成功的六步遷移
blocks.description: 五條向下箭頭表示六個步驟的作業順序；最後依驗收結果決定接受或復原，不表示已執行或已通過。

items.title: 說清楚為什麼要換
items.body: 改善速度、成本、品質或安全

items.title: 確認哪些行為不能變
items.body: 需求、業務規則、資料及權限

items.title: 分析影響範圍
items.body: 程式、介面、資料、環境、操作

items.title: 設定測試與通過標準
items.body: 正常案例、錯誤案例、權限檢查

items.title: 小範圍遷移並實測
items.body: 保留紀錄，比較新舊差異

items.title: 決定接受或復原
items.body: 驗收通過才擴大，失敗就停止

paragraphs: 特別注意兩個概念。
驗收條件（Acceptance Criteria）：你要先講清楚，什麼情況才算成功，而不是做完才決定標準。
例如一個新的客服 AI，至少必須能完成指定的客戶任務、正確處理不知道的問題，且不得洩漏其他客戶資料。可以進一步設定正確率、延遲及成本門檻。
復原（Rollback）：如果新版本失敗，能不能安全退回上一個可用版本？
例如新電商系統上線後，突然不能付款，就應當依事先規劃切回穩定版本，而不是讓顧客持續碰到故障。
但要注意，若資料庫結構或資料內容已改變，單靠 Git 還原程式碼可能不夠，還需要資料相容性與復原方案。

sections.heading: 五、AI 再強，人類為什麼仍要負責？
paragraphs: 假設一家保險公司使用 AI Agent，自動分析理賠申請。
AI 告訴你：「這一筆理賠不符合規定，建議拒絕。」
但是問題來了：
這個規定是誰定義的？AI 是否使用正確版本的條款？如果判錯，誰能修改決策？誰負責處理客戶申訴？
所以工程責任至少包括：
業務負責人決定規則與可接受結果；技術負責人確保系統按照規格實作；資料與安全負責人確認存取及風險控制；驗收負責人根據測試證據決定是否接受。
一個人可以兼任數個角色，但責任不能消失。
教材提到的 NIST AI Risk Management Framework（AI RMF），就是協助組織辨識、評估、治理與管理 AI 風險的框架。採用它不等於取得資安認證，也不代表所有控制措施都已真正落實。

sections.heading: 六、實際練習：幫一家公司制定工具遷移計畫
paragraphs: 假設一家零售公司要把原本的客服聊天機器人，從 AI 模型 A 改成模型 B，原因是希望降低成本。
我們可以先寫出這份簡短的遷移計畫。

blocks.caption: 對照表｜六、實際練習：幫一家公司制定工具遷移計畫
rows: 變更目的
降低每次客服對話成本
不變的需求
能查詢訂單、解釋退貨政策、必要時轉真人
不變的安全規則
不得取得其他客戶的訂單資料
正常案例
顧客能查到自己已授權的訂單
負向案例
顧客提供別人的訂單編號，AI 不應洩漏資訊
驗收標準
核心任務達既定品質門檻、安全測試通過、成本確有改善
停止條件
出現跨客戶資料洩漏、重大錯誤或核心功能失效
復原方式
保留原模型、設定和路由，必要時切回
目前狀態
計畫已完成，尚未執行測試

paragraphs: 最後一列尤其重要。
寫好計畫，不代表已經成功更換模型。跑過幾次測試，也不代表已完成正式驗收。
成熟的工程實務必須區分：
計畫完成 → 實作完成 → 測試通過 → 驗收完成 → 正式交付
每個階段都應有相對應的證據。

sections.heading: 七、這一課與整個軟體工程的關係
paragraphs: 你可以把整個 AASE 系列理解成一條完整的責任鏈：

blocks.caption: 圖 3｜AASE 的五層責任鏈
blocks.description: 五列呈現工程責任的不同層次，沒有通過或因果箭頭。實作技術可以替換，每次仍需檢查其他層受影響的承諾。

items.title: 問題與需求
items.body: 到底要解決什麼？

items.title: 設計與規格
items.body: 應該怎麼運作？

items.title: 系統實作
items.body: 用什麼技術做出來？

items.title: 測試驗收
items.body: 如何證明真的能用？

items.title: 交付與改善
items.body: 如何持續可靠地運作？

paragraphs: 其中技術實作那一層可以經常替換，但替換時必須檢查對其他層的影響。
因此，長期真正值得累積的能力，不只是熟悉某個模型或框架，而是能夠定義問題、制定規格、評估技術變更、驗證結果、控制風險，並交付能持續維護的系統。

sections.heading: 八、理解檢核
paragraphs: 假設你接手了一家診所的預約系統。原本使用單一 AI Agent 與傳統網站，現在公司希望改成多個 Agent 協作，並重新製作前端介面。
請對照下方三題理解檢核及參考解析。
這一課最終希望你建立的判斷習慣是：不要只問「新技術能做什麼」，還要問「替換後，原本承諾的事情，如何證明仍然做得到」。

exercise.environment: 既有作品與測試紀錄，選擇一項假設的工具替換；本練習不必安裝新產品或使用真實資料。
steps: 寫下替換目的、維持不變的契約，以及會影響哪些執行層次。
列出代表任務、負向案例、權限與環境檢查，以及停止及復原條件。
標記目前是遷移計畫、已執行或已驗收；沒有執行就保留未執行。

exercise.check: 不同變更對應不同回歸；保留人類負責角色與原型限制。

en.summary: When replacing tools, preserve confirmed requirements, permissions and acceptance contracts, choosing regression checks by impact rather than brand or version.
objectives: Distinguish replaceable tools from continuing responsibilities.
Explain different impacts of Agent, framework and multiuser changes.
Define migration acceptance and recovery conditions.

readingGuide.goal: Distinguish replaceable tools from continuing responsibilities.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Existing artifacts/tests and one hypothetical tool replacement; no new product installation or real data is required.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: A scoped migration plan with acceptance and recovery conditions, without claiming an untested tool passed.

sections.heading: Changing tools and continuing responsibility
paragraphs: The central idea of this lesson is simple:
Tools may keep changing, but your responsibility for the quality, safety, and correctness of their output continues.

For example, today you might use ChatGPT to write code, tomorrow Claude Code, and later another AI Coding Agent. Tools may become more capable, but you still need to establish whether the program does the right thing, data remains protected, permissions stay controlled, and failures can be recovered from.
This is the central lesson of M09-04.

sections.heading: 1. Start with an everyday example
paragraphs: Imagine that you own a restaurant.
Your kitchen replaces a traditional gas stove with a modern smart induction cooker.
The new equipment may be faster, use less energy, and control temperature automatically.
Three commitments still remain:

- Customers must receive the meals they ordered.
- Food must meet hygiene and safety requirements.
- The restaurant must have a way to handle orders if the new equipment fails.
Therefore:
Changing equipment does not redefine what makes a restaurant good.
The same reasoning applies to software engineering.
Changing a programming language, AI model, development framework, or cloud platform does not erase previously confirmed user requirements, data protections, and acceptance criteria.

sections.heading: 2. What may change, and what must be retained?
paragraphs: Compare replaceable tools with continuing responsibilities.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Replaceable tools and continuing responsibilities
blocks.description: The columns are parallel comparisons and stack on narrow screens. Responsibilities may change with new requirements, through explicit decisions, updated specifications, and renewed verification; tools cannot decide independently.

items.title: Replaceable tools
items.body:
AI models
Coding Agents
UI frameworks
Databases and deployment
Third-party packages

items.title: Continuing responsibilities
items.body:
Actual user needs
Business rules and acceptance criteria
Data security and permissions
Testing and failure recovery
Documentation, handoff, and owners

paragraphs: The responsibilities on the right can also change when requirements change. That requires an explicit decision, updated specifications, and renewed verification; the tool cannot decide on its own.
For example, a hospital originally permits only authorized doctors to view particular medical records.
One day, the hospital replaces its AI medical system.
Even a highly capable replacement does not justify allowing every employee to view those records simply because broader access is convenient.
A tool's capability and a system's authorization are separate matters.

sections.heading: 3. Different technical changes need different checks
paragraphs: This is a practical part of the lesson.
Engineers must distinguish the kinds of change involved in a tool update.

blocks.caption: Comparison | 3. Different technical changes need different checks
rows: Replace the AI Coding Agent
Switch from tool A to tool B for coding
Files the AI can access, commands it can run, and whether changes meet specifications
Replace the UI framework
Move a website from Vue to React
Buttons, input, screen state, downloads, keyboard operation, and deployment
Move from one user to many
Turn a personal bookkeeping tool into a shared company system
Identity, separation of users' data, authorization, and audit records

paragraphs: ### Example A: replace the AI Coding Agent
Suppose you use AI to develop a bank loan calculator.
Tool A correctly calculates monthly repayments. You now want to use tool B.
Asking whether tool B writes code faster is only a starting point.
Also ask:

Did tool B read the correct requirements? Could it alter a core formula that should remain unchanged? Can it preserve a reviewable code diff? Could an external-service call transmit sensitive data without authorization?
Replacing an AI development tool therefore calls for checking the development process, tool permissions, and actual changes produced.
If you change the tool without executing the program again, you cannot claim that the replacement has passed acceptance.
### Example B: replace the frontend UI framework
Suppose a school has a grade-query website.
It was built in Vue and is now being migrated to React.
The semester-average formula remains unchanged, but the website could still develop these failures:

- Clicking the query button produces no response.
- The grade screen displays the previous student's data.
- The PDF export button stops working.
- The mobile interface becomes unusable.
Passing every unit test for average calculation therefore does not establish that the website migration succeeded.
This introduces an important term:
Regression testing checks that previously working behavior still works after a change.
A UI-framework replacement requires retesting affected UI behavior as well as the original calculation rules.
### Example C: move from one user to many
Suppose you wrote a personal bookkeeping tool used only by you.
You now want to offer it to one hundred companies.
Even if its existing functions are correct, the original program is not ready for that deployment without further work.
There are new questions to address:
Can employees of company A see company B's accounts? Can managers access employees' private data? When are departing employees' permissions revoked? Do data operations leave audit records?
Adding a login page alone does not resolve these questions.
The system's identity management, authorization model, and data governance have changed.

sections.heading: 4. Define success before migrating
paragraphs: A general process can guide technical replacement across industries.

blocks.caption: Figure 2 | Six migration steps, starting with success criteria
blocks.description: Five downward arrows show the working order of six steps. Acceptance evidence determines whether to accept or recover; the diagram does not claim execution or success.

items.title: Explain the reason for change
items.body: Improve speed, cost, quality, or safety

items.title: Identify behavior to retain
items.body: Requirements, business rules, data, and permissions

items.title: Analyze the impact
items.body: Code, interfaces, data, environments, and operations

items.title: Define tests and pass criteria
items.body: Normal cases, error cases, and authorization checks

items.title: Migrate a small scope and execute tests
items.body: Retain records and compare old and new behavior

items.title: Accept or recover
items.body: Expand only after acceptance; stop on failure

paragraphs: Two concepts deserve particular attention.
Acceptance criteria state in advance what counts as success, rather than allowing the standard to be chosen after the work is done.

For example, a replacement customer-service AI must complete specified customer tasks, handle unknown answers appropriately, and avoid leaking other customers' data. Quality, latency, and cost thresholds can make these criteria more precise.
Rollback asks whether a failed replacement can safely return to a previous working version.
If a new e-commerce system cannot process payments after release, use the recovery plan to switch to a stable version instead of leaving customers to encounter the failure.
If database schemas or stored data have changed, reverting code in Git may be insufficient. Data compatibility and a recovery plan are also needed.

sections.heading: 5. Why people remain responsible as AI becomes more capable
paragraphs: Suppose an insurer uses an AI Agent to analyze claims automatically.
The AI says, “This claim does not meet the rules; rejection is recommended.”
That raises questions:
Who defined the rule? Did the AI use the correct version of the policy? Who can correct a mistaken decision? Who handles a customer's appeal?
Engineering responsibility therefore includes at least these roles:

The business owner defines rules and acceptable outcomes; the technical owner ensures implementation follows specifications; data and security owners check access and risk controls; the acceptance owner decides whether to accept the result based on test evidence.
One person can hold several roles, but each responsibility still needs an owner.

The NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF) helps organizations identify, assess, govern, and manage AI risks. Using it does not establish security certification or prove that all controls have actually been implemented.

sections.heading: 6. Practice: plan a company's tool migration
paragraphs: A retailer wants to replace customer-service AI model A with model B to reduce costs.
Start with this short migration plan.

blocks.caption: Comparison | 6. Practice: plan a company's tool migration
rows: Change goal
Reduce the cost of each customer-service conversation
Requirements to retain
Query orders, explain return policy, and escalate to a person when needed
Security rule to retain
Never obtain another customer's order data
Normal case
Customers can retrieve their own authorized orders
Negative case
Providing someone else's order number must not disclose their information
Acceptance criteria
Core tasks meet predefined quality thresholds, security tests pass, and costs actually improve
Stop conditions
Cross-customer disclosure, major errors, or loss of core functionality
Recovery
Retain the old model, settings, and routing so traffic can switch back when needed
Current status
Plan complete; tests not yet executed

paragraphs: The last row matters.
Writing a plan does not establish a successful model replacement. A few test runs do not establish formal acceptance either.
Engineering records need to distinguish:
Plan complete → implementation complete → tests passed → acceptance complete → formal delivery
Each stage needs corresponding evidence.

sections.heading: 7. How this lesson connects to software engineering
paragraphs: Think of the AASE series as a chain of responsibilities:

blocks.caption: Figure 3 | Five layers of AASE responsibility
blocks.description: The rows identify different engineering responsibilities, without success or causal arrows. Implementation technology may change; each replacement still requires checking commitments in the other layers.

items.title: Problem and requirements
items.body: What problem are we solving?

items.title: Design and specification
items.body: How should it work?

items.title: System implementation
items.body: Which technology implements it?

items.title: Testing and acceptance
items.body: How do we establish that it works?

items.title: Delivery and improvement
items.body: How can it keep operating reliably?

paragraphs: The technical implementation layer can change frequently, but each replacement requires checking its effects on the other layers.

Capabilities worth developing over time include defining problems, specifying behavior, assessing technical changes, verifying results, controlling risk, and delivering maintainable systems, alongside knowledge of particular models and frameworks.

sections.heading: 8. Check your understanding
paragraphs: You inherit a clinic's appointment system. It uses one AI Agent and a conventional website; the company now wants several collaborating Agents and a rebuilt frontend.
Consider the three questions in the understanding checks below.
The judgment to practice is to ask what evidence demonstrates that existing commitments still hold after replacing technology, alongside asking what the new technology can do.

exercise.environment: Existing artifacts/tests and one hypothetical tool replacement; no new product installation or real data is required.
steps: State the replacement goal, contracts to preserve and affected execution layers.
List representative tasks, negative cases, permission/environment checks and stop/recovery conditions.
Mark whether work is a plan, executed change or accepted result; preserve unexecuted status when nothing ran.
exercise.expected: A scoped migration plan with acceptance and recovery conditions, without claiming an untested tool passed.
exercise.check: Match regression scope to the change; retain human owners and prototype limits.
exercise.cleanup: Keep the plan and open decisions. Reading this lesson does not trigger installation, payment or deployment.

zh.prompt: 這次更換技術時，哪一種做法最合理？
options: 新模型比較強，直接替換即可
保留既有需求與權限契約，先分析影響再遷移
把所有規格清空，讓 AI 重新決定
rationales: 模型能力不能證明需求與權限仍被遵守。
先保留契約、分析影響，再用對應證據驗收。
需求與驗收標準需要明確負責人決策。

en.prompt: Which approach best fits this technology change?
options: Replace it directly because the new model is stronger.
Retain requirements and permission contracts, analyze impact, then migrate.
Erase all specifications and let AI decide again.
rationales: Model capability does not establish compliance with requirements and permissions.
Retain contracts, assess impact, then accept using relevant evidence.
Requirements and acceptance criteria need decisions by named owners.

zh.prompt: 舊版預約規則測試全部通過，是否代表新版 UI 已驗收完成？
options: 是，核心規則沒壞就夠了
否，仍需測試操作流程、畫面狀態與部署等變更
是，只要使用知名 UI 框架就可以
rationales: 規則測試不涵蓋所有 UI 整合行為。
遷移的驗證範圍必須包含受影響的 UI 與部署。
框架品牌不能代替實際驗證。

en.prompt: Do passing old appointment-rule tests establish acceptance of the new UI?
options: Yes; intact core rules are sufficient.
No; test changed workflows, screen state, deployment, and other affected behavior.
Yes, provided a well-known UI framework is used.
rationales: Rule tests do not cover every UI integration behavior.
Migration verification must include affected UI and deployment behavior.
A framework brand cannot replace actual verification.

zh.prompt: 新的 AI Agent 自行決定擴大病歷存取權限，應該怎麼處理？
options: 接受，因為 AI 是為了完成任務
只要運作正常就不必記錄
停止未授權變更，由負責人確認權限與規格
rationales: 完成任務不授予額外資料權限。
正常畫面無法證明授權正確，變更仍需追溯。
由負責人決策並更新規格、重新驗證後才可採用。

en.prompt: What should happen if the new AI Agent independently expands medical-record access?
options: Accept it because the AI is completing its task.
Leave it unrecorded if operation appears normal.
Stop the unauthorized change and have owners confirm permissions and specifications.
rationales: Task completion grants no extra data permissions.
An apparently working screen does not prove correct authorization; changes need traceability.
Owners must decide, update specifications, and reverify before adoption.
